messages:
sarah: Heads-up — we're planning RBAC migration for tenant 'RollerCo' next week. They require: 1) proof of role changes (audit logs), 2) key material provenance for KMS, 3) emergency access runbook. Can infra/security confirm what artifacts we can provide by EOD tomorrow? :clock1:

mike: Can you list the exact roles they want changed? We have to map to service accounts vs console roles.

sarah: They want app-readonly -> app-reader-service, and a scoped write role for a lambda-like worker. Also temporary admin for 24h during migration.

ajay: For logs: we can export admin role changes from our audit pipeline. Query in ELK is:
```
index:redwood-audit action:role_change tenant:rollerco | sort @timestamp desc | head 200
```
We'll generate a signed export (GPG) and timestamp.

luca: For KMS we can provide key metadata + rotation history. Not raw key material. The customer asked for "key provenance" — we'll include: key id, creation date, rotation events, HSM attestations, KMS policy snapshots.

mike: Who owns generating the GPG-signed artifact? I can do a one-off but prefer infra to automate.

ajay: I'll script the export and push to a pre-auth S3 bucket. Command prototype:
```
python tools/export_audit.py --tenant rollerco --since 2025-10-01 --format jsonl | gpg --sign > rollerco-audit-20251001.gpg
```
I'll add metadata file with sha256.

sarah: Good. Also customer asked for log retention proof — how long do we keep role-change logs?

luca: We retain audit logs 5 years for enterprise, default 90 days for self-serve. For this tenant it's 5 years per contract. We'll add retention policy reference and storage class audit.

sec-bot: Security checklist link: https://console.redwood.internal/sec/checklists/rbac-migration :lock:

mike: Quick vuln question — migration will touch service account tokens. Any plan for rotating tokens and mitigating exposure?

luca: Yes. Rotate tokens before cutover, disable old tokens after canary. We have IR playbook steps 1-6. I'll paste step snippet:
```
1. Create scoped service account
2. Issue new token (expires 24h)
3. Gradual cutover on canary route
4. Monitor errors > 5% rollback
5. Rotate old secrets and revoke
```

sarah: Perfect. Can someone assemble the bundle (signed audit export, KMS metadata, retention policy, IR snippet) and upload to the customer portal? Need by 10:00 AM PST tomorrow.

ajay: I'll upload to s3://sec-evidence/rollerco/2025-10-01/ and share a pre-signed URL.

mike: I'll run a dry-run of the GPG sign today and post the artifact hash.

luca: I'll prepare a short cover letter explaining what's included and what we cannot provide (no raw key material, no HSM private attestations beyond vendor-signed statements).

sarah: Thanks team :tada: Please @sarah in the thread when uploaded.
